species.desc: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.

species.name: Feraligatr
species.desc: The Big Jaw Pokémon. Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.

species.name: Sentret
species.desc: The Scout Pokémon. When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.

species.name: Furret
species.desc: The Long Body Pokémon. Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.

species.name: Hoothoot
species.desc: The Owl Pokémon. It cries out at the same time every day. A long time ago, people cherished it and considered it a divine messenger sent to tell the time.

species.name: Noctowl
species.desc: The Owl Pokémon. When it turns its head entirely upside down, you know it’s troubled by something. If you don’t leave it be, it will peck you.

species.name: Ledyba
species.desc: The Five Star Pokémon. These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.

species.name: Ledian
species.desc: The Five Star Pokémon. It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.

species.name: Spinarak
species.desc: The String Spit Pokémon. Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.

species.name: Ariados
species.desc: The Long Leg Pokémon. Every night, it wanders around in search of prey, whose movements it restrains by spewing threads before it bites into them with its fangs.

species.name: Crobat
species.desc: The Bat Pokémon. It feeds on the blood of living people and Pokémon. If it can’t drink any blood for even a short while, it becomes weak and unable to fly.

species.name: Chinchou
species.desc: The Angler Pokémon. Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

species.name: Lanturn
species.desc: The Light Pokémon. It lives far down in the depths of the ocean. It blinds its prey with light, using the moment they’re dazzled to swallow them whole.

species.name: Pichu
species.desc: The Tiny Mouse Pokémon. It still can’t use electricity well. When it’s surprised or excited, it discharges electricity unintentionally.

species.name: Cleffa
species.desc: The Star Shape Pokémon. On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!

species.name: Igglybuff
species.desc: The Balloon Pokémon. Left to its own devices, it will constantly practice singing. You should make it take a break so it doesn’t hurt its throat.

species.name: Togepi
species.desc: The Spike Ball Pokémon. As its energy, Togepi uses the positive emotions of compassion and pleasure exuded by people and Pokémon. This Pokémon stores up feelings of happiness inside its shell, then shares them with others.

species.name: Togetic
species.desc: The Happiness Pokémon. Togetic is said to be a Pokémon that brings good fortune. When the Pokémon spots someone who is pure of heart, it is said to appear and share its happiness with that person.

species.name: Natu
species.desc: The Tiny Bird Pokémon. The look in its eyes gives the impression that it’s carefully observing you. If you approach it, Natu will hop away.

species.name: Xatu
species.desc: The Mystic Pokémon. It’s said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it’s not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

species.name: Mareep
species.desc: The Wool Pokémon. Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.

species.name: Flaaffy
species.desc: The Wool Pokémon. In the places on its body where fleece doesn’t grow, its skin is rubbery and doesn’t conduct electricity. Those spots are safe to touch.

species.name: Ampharos
species.desc: The Light Pokémon. The light from its tail can be seen from space. This is why you can always tell exactly where it is, which is why it usually keeps the light off.

species.name: Bellossom
species.desc: The Flower Pokémon. A Bellossom grows flowers more beautifully if it has evolved from a smelly Gloom-the more stinky the better. At night, this Pokémon closes its petals and goes to sleep.

species.name: Marill
species.desc: The Aqua Mouse Pokémon. When fishing for food at the edge of a fast-running stream, Marill wraps its tail around the trunk of a tree. This Pokémon's tail is flexible and configured to stretch.

species.name: Azumarill
species.desc: The Aqua Rabbit Pokémon. Azumarill's long ears are indispensable sensors. By focusing its hearing, this Pokémon can identify what kinds of prey are around, even in rough and fast-running rivers.

species.name: Sudowoodo
species.desc: The Imitation Pokémon. It’s so popular with the elderly that there’s a magazine devoted to this Pokémon. Fans obsess over the particular length and angle of its arms.

species.name: Politoed
species.desc: The Frog Pokémon. The longer and more luxurious the curled hair on its head, the greater the number of Poliwag and Poliwhirl that will obey it.

species.name: Hoppip
species.desc: The Cottonweed Pokémon. This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

species.name: Skiploom
species.desc: The Cottonweed Pokémon. Skiploom's flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.

species.name: Jumpluff
species.desc: The Cottonweed Pokémon. Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.

species.name: Aipom
species.desc: The Long Tail Pokémon. It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.

species.name: Sunkern
species.desc: The Seed Pokémon. Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.

species.name: Sunflora
species.desc: The Sun Pokémon. Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.

species.name: Yanma
species.desc: The Clear Wing Pokémon. Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.

species.name: Paldean Wooper
species.desc: The Poison Fish Pokémon. After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

species.name: Wooper
species.desc: The Water Fish Pokémon. Wooper usually lives in water. However, it occasionally comes out onto land in search of food. On land, it coats its body with a gooey, toxic film.

species.name: Quagsire
species.desc: The Water Fish Pokémon. Quagsire hunts for food by leaving its mouth wide open in water and waiting for its prey to blunder in unaware. Because the Pokémon does not move, it does not get very hungry.

species.name: Espeon
species.desc: The Sun Pokémon. Espeon is extremely loyal to any Trainer it considers to be worthy. It is said that this Pokémon developed its precognitive powers to protect its Trainer from harm.

species.name: Umbreon
species.desc: The Moonlight Pokémon. Umbreon evolved as a result of exposure to the moon's waves. It hides silently in darkness and waits for its foes to make a move. The rings on its body glow when it leaps to attack.

species.name: Murkrow
species.desc: The Darkness Pokémon. Murkrow was feared and loathed as the alleged bearer of ill fortune. This Pokémon shows strong interest in anything that sparkles or glitters. It will even try to steal rings from women.

species.name: Galarian Slowking
species.desc: The Hexpert Pokémon. A combination of toxins and the shock of evolving has increased Shellder's intelligence to the point that Shellder now controls Slowking.

species.name: Slowking
species.desc: The Royal Pokémon. Slowking undertakes research every day in an effort to solve the mysteries of the world. However, this Pokémon apparently forgets everything it has learned if the Shellder on its head comes off.

species.name: Misdreavus
species.desc: The Screech Pokémon. Misdreavus frightens people with a creepy, sobbing cry. The Pokémon apparently uses its red spheres to absorb the fearful feelings of foes and turn them into nutrition.

species.name: Unown
species.desc: The Symbol Pokémon. This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.

species.name: Wobbuffet
species.desc: The Patient Pokémon. Wobbuffet does nothing but endure attacks-it won't attack on its own. However, it won't endure an attack on its tail. When that happens, the Pokémon will try to take the foe with it using Destiny Bond.

species.name: Girafarig
species.desc: The Long Neck Pokémon. Girafarig's rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn't need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.

species.name: Pineco
species.desc: The Bagworm Pokémon. Pineco hangs from a tree branch and patiently waits for prey to come along. If the Pokémon is disturbed while eating by someone shaking its tree, it drops down to the ground and explodes with no warning.

species.name: Forretress
species.desc: The Bagworm Pokémon. Forretress conceals itself inside its hardened steel shell. The shell is opened when the Pokémon is catching prey, but it does so at such a quick pace that the shell's inside cannot be seen.

species.name: Dunsparce
species.desc: The Land Snake Pokémon. Dunsparce has a drill for its tail. It uses this tail to burrow into the ground backward. This Pokémon is known to make its nest in complex shapes deep under the ground.

species.name: Gligar
species.desc: The Fly Scorpion Pokémon. Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
evTo: Gliscor (level 10, using Razor Fang, during the night)

species.name: Steelix
species.desc: The Iron Snake Pokémon. Steelix lives even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth's core. There are records of this Pokémon reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

species.name: Snubbull
species.desc: The Fairy Pokémon. By baring its fangs and making a scary face, Snubbull sends smaller Pokémon scurrying away in terror. However, this Pokémon seems a little sad at making its foes flee.

species.name: Granbull
species.desc: The Fairy Pokémon. Granbull has a particularly well-developed lower jaw. The enormous fangs are heavy, causing the Pokémon to tip its head back for balance. Unless it is startled, it will not try to bite indiscriminately.

species.name: Hisuian Qwilfish
species.desc: The Balloon Pokémon. Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.

species.name: Qwilfish
species.desc: The Balloon Pokémon. Qwilfish sucks in water, inflating itself. This Pokémon uses the pressure of the water it swallowed to shoot toxic quills all at once from all over its body. It finds swimming somewhat challenging.

species.name: Scizor
species.desc: The Pincer Pokémon. Scizor has a body with the hardness of steel. It is not easily fazed by ordinary sorts of attacks. This Pokémon flaps its wings to regulate its body temperature.

species.name: Shuckle
species.desc: The Mold Pokémon. Shuckle quietly hides itself under rocks, keeping its body concealed inside its hard shell while eating berries it has stored away. The berries mix with its body fluids to become a juice.

species.name: Heracross
species.desc: The Single Horn Pokémon. Heracross charges in a straight line at its foe, slips beneath the foe's grasp, and then scoops up and hurls the opponent with its mighty horn. This Pokémon even has enough power to topple a massive tree.

species.name: Hisuian Sneasel
species.desc: The Sharp Claw Pokémon. Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel’s grasp.
evTo: Sneasler (level 10, using Razor Claw, during the day)

species.name: Sneasel
species.desc: The Sharp Claw Pokémon. Sneasel scales trees by punching its hooked claws into the bark. This Pokémon seeks out unguarded nests and steals eggs for food while the parents are away.
evTo: Weavile (level 10, using Razor Claw, during the night)

species.name: Teddiursa
species.desc: The Little Bear Pokémon. This Pokémon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. Teddiursa concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.

species.name: Ursaring
species.desc: The Hibernator Pokémon. In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokémon walks through its forest gathering food every day.
evTo: Ursaluna (level 14, using Peat Block, under a full moon)

species.name: Slugma
species.desc: The Lava Pokémon. Molten magma courses throughout Slugma's circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.

species.name: Magcargo
species.desc: The Lava Pokémon. Magcargo's body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.

species.name: Swinub
species.desc: The Pig Pokémon. Swinub roots for food by rubbing its snout against the ground. Its favorite food is a mushroom that grows under the cover of dead grass. This Pokémon occasionally roots out hot springs.

species.name: Piloswine
species.desc: The Swine Pokémon. Piloswine is covered by a thick coat of long hair that enables it to endure the freezing cold. This Pokémon uses its tusks to dig up food that has been buried under ice.

species.name: Corsola
species.desc: The Coral Pokémon. Corsola's branches glitter very beautifully in seven colors when they catch sunlight. If any branch breaks off, this Pokémon grows it back in just one night.

species.name: Galarian Corsola
species.desc: The Coral Pokémon. Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.

species.name: Remoraid
species.desc: The Jet Pokémon. This Pokémon clings to Mantine and shares in its prosperity. When its Mantine is attacked, Remoraid will fight alongside it!

species.name: Octillery
species.desc: The Jet Pokémon. The ink it spits when escaping is special. It contains a substance that dulls the sense of smell, so Pokémon with keen noses get lost.

species.name: Delibird
species.desc: The Delivery Pokémon. It shares its food with people who are stranded. Because Delibird is omnivorous, sometimes it gives those people bug Pokémon.

species.name: Mantine
species.desc: The Kite Pokémon. Many people have taken up surfing because they admire how magnificently Mantine swims.

species.name: Skarmory
species.desc: The Armor Bird Pokémon. he wing feathers it sheds can be processed and made into knives whose sharpness is recognized by the finest chefs.

species.name: Houndour
species.desc: The Dark Pokémon. It cooperates with others skillfully. When it becomes your partner, it’s very loyal to you as its Trainer and will obey your orders.

species.name: Houndoom
species.desc: The Dark Pokémon. They spew flames mixed with poison to finish off their opponents. They divvy up their prey evenly among the members of their pack.

species.name: Kingdra
species.desc: The Dragon Pokémon. Kingdra lives at extreme ocean depths that are otherwise uninhabited. It has long been believed that the yawning of this Pokémon creates spiraling ocean currents.

species.name: Phanpy
species.desc: The Long Nose Pokémon. For its nest, Phanpy digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.

species.name: Donphan
species.desc: The Armor Pokémon. Donphan's favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can't stop very easily.

species.name: Porygon2
species.desc: The Virtual Pokémon. Porygon2 was created by humans using the power of science. The man-made Pokémon has been endowed with artificial intelligence that enables it to learn new gestures and emotions on its own.

species.name: Stantler
species.desc: The Big Horn Pokémon. Stantler's magnificent antlers were traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction by those who were after the priceless antlers.

species.name: Smeargle
species.desc: The Painter Pokémon. Smeargle marks the boundaries of its territory using a body fluid that leaks out from the tip of its tail. Over 5,000 different marks left by this Pokémon have been found.

species.name: Tyrogue
species.desc: The Scuffle Pokémon. Tyrogue becomes stressed out if it does not get to train every day. When raising this Pokémon, the Trainer must establish and uphold various training methods.
evTo: Hitmonchan (level 6, if its STR is higher than its DEX)
Hitmonlee (level 6, if its DEX is higher than its STR)
Hitmontop (level 6, if its STR is equal to its DEX)

species.name: Hitmontop
species.desc: The Handstand Pokémon. Hitmontop spins on its head at high speed, all the while delivering kicks. This technique is a remarkable mix of both offense and defense at the same time. The Pokémon travels faster spinning than it does walking.

species.name: Smoochum
species.desc: The Kiss Pokémon. Smoochum actively runs about, but also falls quite often. Whenever the chance arrives, it will look for its reflection to make sure its face hasn't become dirty.

species.name: Elekid
species.desc: The Electric Pokémon. Elekid stores electricity in its body. If it touches metal and accidentally discharges all its built-up electricity, this Pokémon begins swinging its arms in circles to recharge itself.

species.name: Magby
species.desc: The Live Coal Pokémon. Magby's state of health is determined by observing the fire it breathes. If the Pokémon is spouting yellow flames from its mouth, it is in good health. When it is fatigued, black smoke will be mixed in with the flames.

species.name: Miltank
species.desc: The Milk Cow Pokémon. Miltank gives over five gallons of milk on a daily basis. Its sweet milk is enjoyed by children and grown-ups alike. People who can't drink milk turn it into yogurt and eat it instead.

species.name: Blissey
species.desc: The Happiness Pokémon. Blissey senses sadness with its fluffy coat of fur. If it does so, this Pokémon will rush over to a sad person, no matter how far away, to share a Lucky Egg that brings a smile to any face.

species.name: Raikou
species.desc: The Thunder Pokémon. Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.

species.name: Entei
species.desc: The Volcano Pokémon. Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.

species.name: Suicune
species.desc: The Aurora Pokémon. Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.

species.name: Larvitar
species.desc: The Rock Skin Pokémon. Larvitar is born deep under the ground. To come up to the surface, this Pokémon must eat its way through the soil above. Until it does so, Larvitar cannot see its parents.

species.name: Pupitar
species.desc: The Hard Shell Pokémon. Pupitar creates a gas inside its body that it compresses and forcefully ejects to propel itself like a jet. The body is very durable-it avoids damage even if it hits solid steel.

species.name: Tyranitar
species.desc: The Armor Pokémon. Tyranitar is so overwhelmingly powerful, it can bring down a whole mountain to make its nest. This Pokémon wanders about in mountains seeking new opponents to fight.

species.name: Lugia
species.desc: The Diving Pokémon. Lugia's wings pack devastating power-a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.

species.name: Ho-oh
species.desc: The Rainbow Pokémon. Ho-Oh's feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.

species.name: Celebi
species.desc: The Time Travel Pokémon. This Pokémon came from the future by crossing over time. It is thought that so long as Celebi appears, a bright and shining future awaits us.

species.name: Treecko
species.desc: The Wood Gecko Pokémon. Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.

species.name: Grovyle
species.desc: The Wood Gecko Pokémon. The leaves growing out of Grovyle's body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.

species.name: Sceptile
species.desc: The Forest Pokémon. The leaves growing on Sceptile's body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile-it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.

species.name: Torchic
species.desc: The Chick Pokémon. Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug-it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.

species.name: Combusken
species.desc: The Young Fowl Pokémon. Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon's cry is very loud and distracting.

species.name: Blaziken
species.desc: The Blaze Pokémon. In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon's wrists burn.

species.name: Mudkip
species.desc: The Mud Fish Pokémon. The fin on Mudkip's head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.

species.name: Marshtomp
species.desc: The Mud Fish Pokémon. The surface of Marshtomp's body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.

species.name: Swampert
species.desc: The Mud Fish Pokémon. Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.

species.name: Poochyena
species.desc: The Bite Pokémon. At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.

species.name: Mightyena
species.desc: The Bite Pokémon. Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.

species.name: Galarian Zigzagoon
species.desc: The Tiny Raccoon Pokémon. Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.

species.name: Zigzagoon
species.desc: The Tiny Raccoon Pokémon. Zigzagoon restlessly wanders everywhere at all times. This Pokémon does so because it is very curious. It becomes interested in anything that it happens to see.

species.name: Galarian Linoone
species.desc: The Rushing Pokémon. It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.

species.name: Linoone
species.desc: The Rushing Pokémon. Linoone always runs full speed and only in straight lines. If facing an obstacle, it makes a right-angle turn to evade it. This Pokémon is very challenged by gently curving roads.

species.name: Wurmple
species.desc: The Worm Pokémon. Using the spikes on its rear end, Wurmple peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon's feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.

species.name: Silcoon
species.desc: The Cocoon Pokémon. Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.

species.name: Beautifly
species.desc: The Butterfly Pokémon. Beautifly's favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.

species.name: Cascoon
species.desc: The Cocoon Pokémon. Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.

species.name: Dustox
species.desc: The Poison Moth Pokémon. Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.

species.name: Lotad
species.desc: The Water Weed Pokémon. Lotad live in ponds and lakes, where they float on the surface. It grows weak if its broad leaf dies. On rare occasions, this Pokémon travels on land in search of clean water.

species.name: Lombre
species.desc: The Jolly Pokémon. Lombre is nocturnal-it will get active after dusk. It is also a mischief maker. When this Pokémon spots anglers, it tugs on their fishing lines from beneath the surface and enjoys their consternation.

species.name: Ludicolo
species.desc: The Carefree Pokémon. Ludicolo begins dancing as soon as it hears cheerful, festive music. This Pokémon is said to appear when it hears the singing of children on hiking outings.

species.name: Seedot
species.desc: The Acorn Pokémon. Seedot attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. It sucks moisture from the tree while hanging off the branch. The more water it drinks, the glossier this Pokémon's body becomes.

species.name: Nuzleaf
species.desc: The Wily Pokémon. Nuzleaf live in densely overgrown forests. They occasionally venture out of the forest to startle people. This Pokémon dislikes having its long nose pinched.

species.name: Shiftry
species.desc: The Wicked Pokémon. Shiftry is a mysterious Pokémon that is said to live atop towering trees dating back over a thousand years. It creates terrific windstorms with the fans it holds.

species.name: Taillow
species.desc: The Tiny Swallow Pokémon. Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.

species.name: Swellow
species.desc: The Swallow Pokémon. Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow's clawed feet, preventing escape.

species.name: Wingull
species.desc: The Seagull Pokémon. Wingull has the habit of carrying prey and valuables in its beak and hiding them in all sorts of locations. This Pokémon rides the winds and flies as if it were skating across the sky.

species.name: Pelipper
species.desc: The Water Bird Pokémon. Pelipper is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon and eggs inside its massive bill. This Pokémon builds its nest on steep cliffs facing the sea.

species.name: Ralts
species.desc: The Feeling Pokémon. Ralts senses the emotions of people using the horns on its head. This Pokémon rarely appears before people. But when it does, it draws closer if it senses that the person has a positive disposition.

species.name: Kirlia
species.desc: The Emotion Pokémon. It is said that a Kirlia that is exposed to the positive emotions of its Trainer grows beautiful. This Pokémon controls psychokinetic powers with its highly developed brain.
evTo: Gallade (level 12, male only, using Dawn Stone)

species.name: Gardevoir
species.desc: The Embrace Pokémon. Gardevoir has the ability to read the future. If it senses impending danger to its Trainer, this Pokémon is said to unleash its psychokinetic energy at full power.

species.name: Surskit
species.desc: The Pond Skater Pokémon. If Surskit senses danger, it secretes a thick, sugary syrup from the tip of its head. There are some Pokémon that love eating this syrup.

species.name: Masquerain
species.desc: The Eyeball Pokémon. Masquerain intimidates enemies with the eyelike patterns on its antennas. This Pokémon flaps its four wings to freely fly in any direction-even sideways and backwards-as if it were a helicopter.

species.name: Shroomish
species.desc: The Mushroom Pokémon. If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon's spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.

species.name: Breloom
species.desc: The Mushroom Pokémon. Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon's fighting technique puts boxers to shame.

species.name: Slakoth
species.desc: The Slacker Pokémon. Slakoth's heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

species.name: Vigoroth
species.desc: The Wild Monkey Pokémon. Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can't tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon's stress level rises if it can't be moving constantly.

species.name: Slaking
species.desc: The Lazy Pokémon. Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.

species.name: Nincada
species.desc: The Trainee Pokémon. Nincada lives underground for many years in complete darkness. This Pokémon absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees. It stays motionless as it waits for evolution.
evTo: Shedinja (level 6, when its trainer has an empty pokeball when Nincada evolves into Ninjask)

species.name: Ninjask
species.desc: The Ninja Pokémon. Ninjask moves around at such a high speed that it cannot be seen, even while its crying can be clearly heard. For that reason, this Pokémon was long believed to be invisible.

species.name: Shedinja
species.desc: The Shed Pokémon. Shedinja's hard body doesn't move-not even a twitch. In fact, its body appears to be merely a hollow shell. It is believed that this Pokémon will steal the spirit of anyone peering into its hollow body from its back.

species.name: Whismur
species.desc: The Whisper Pokémon. Normally, Whismur's voice is very quiet-it is barely audible even if one is paying close attention. However, if this Pokémon senses danger, it starts crying at an earsplitting volume.

species.name: Loudred
species.desc: The Big Voice Pokémon. Loudred's bellowing can completely decimate a wood-frame house. It uses its voice to punish its foes. This Pokémon's round ears serve as loudspeakers.

species.name: Exploud
species.desc: The Loud Noise Pokémon. Exploud triggers earthquakes with the tremors it creates by bellowing. If this Pokémon violently inhales from the ports on its body, it's a sign that it is preparing to let loose a huge bellow.

species.name: Makuhita
species.desc: The Guts Pokémon. Makuhita is tenacious-it will keep getting up and attacking its foe however many times it is knocked down. Every time it gets back up, this Pokémon stores more energy in its body for evolving.

species.name: Hariyama
species.desc: The Arm Thrust Pokémon. Hariyama practices its straight-arm slaps in any number of locations. One hit of this Pokémon's powerful, openhanded, straight-arm punches could snap a telephone pole in two.

species.name: Azurill
species.desc: The Polka Dot Pokémon. Azurill spins its tail as if it were a lasso, then hurls it far. The momentum of the throw sends its body flying, too. Using this unique action, one of these Pokémon managed to hurl itself a record 33 feet.

species.name: Nosepass
species.desc: The Compass Pokémon. Nosepass's magnetic nose is always pointed to the north. If two of these Pokémon meet, they cannot turn their faces to each other when they are close because their magnetic noses repel one another.

species.name: Skitty
species.desc: The Kitten Pokémon. Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.

species.name: Delcatty
species.desc: The Prim Pokémon. Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.

species.name: Sableye
species.desc: The Darkness Pokémon. Sableye digs the ground with sharpened claws to find rocks that it eats. Substances in the eaten rocks crystallize and rise up to the Pokémon's body surface.

species.name: Mawile
species.desc: The Deceiver Pokémon. Mawile's huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed. Its docile-looking face serves to lull its foe into letting down its guard. When the foe least expects it, Mawile chomps it with its gaping jaws.

species.name: Aron
species.desc: The Iron Armor Pokémon. This Pokémon has a body of steel. To make its body, Aron feeds on iron ore that it digs from mountains. Occasionally, it causes major trouble by eating bridges and rails.

species.name: Lairon
species.desc: The Iron Armor Pokémon. Lairon tempers its steel body by drinking highly nutritious mineral springwater until it is bloated. This Pokémon makes its nest close to springs of delicious water.

species.name: Aggron
species.desc: The Iron Armor Pokémon. Aggron claims an entire mountain as its own territory. It mercilessly beats up anything that violates its environment. This Pokémon vigilantly patrols its territory at all times.

species.name: Meditite
species.desc: The Meditate Pokémon. Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon's training.

species.name: Medicham
species.desc: The Meditate Pokémon. It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.

species.name: Electrike
species.desc: The Lightning Pokémon. Electrike runs faster than the human eye can follow. The friction from running is converted into electricity, which is then stored in this Pokémon's fur.

species.name: Manectric
species.desc: The Discharge Pokémon. Manectric is constantly discharging electricity from its mane. The sparks sometimes ignite forest fires. When it enters a battle, this Pokémon creates thunderclouds.

species.name: Plusle
species.desc: The Cheering Pokémon. When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.

species.name: Minun
species.desc: The Cheering Pokémon. Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.

species.name: Volbeat
species.desc: The Firefly Pokémon. Volbeat's tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.

species.name: Illumise
species.desc: The Firefly Pokémon. Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.

species.name: Roselia
species.desc: The Thorn Pokémon. Roselia shoots sharp thorns as projectiles at any opponent that tries to steal the flowers on its arms. The aroma of this Pokémon brings serenity to living things.

species.name: Gulpin
species.desc: The Stomach Pokémon. Most of Gulpin's body is made up of its stomach-its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon's stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.

species.name: Swalot
species.desc: The Poison Bag Pokémon. Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon's mouth.

species.name: Carvanha
species.desc: The Savage Pokémon. If anything invades Carvanha's territory, it will swarm and tear at the intruder with its pointed fangs. On its own, however, this Pokémon turns suddenly timid.

species.name: Sharpedo
species.desc: The Brutal Pokémon. Sharpedo can swim at speeds of up to 75 mph by jetting seawater out of its backside. This Pokémon's drawback is its inability to swim long distances.

species.name: Wailmer
species.desc: The Ball Whale Pokémon. Wailmer's nostrils are located above its eyes. This playful Pokémon loves to startle people by forcefully snorting out seawater it stores inside its body out of its nostrils.

species.name: Wailord
species.desc: The Float Whale Pokémon. Wailord is the largest of all identified Pokémon up to now. This giant Pokémon swims languorously in the vast open sea, eating massive amounts of food at once with its enormous mouth.

species.name: Numel
species.desc: The Numb Pokémon. Numel is extremely dull witted-it doesn't notice being hit. However, it can't stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon's body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.

species.name: Camerupt
species.desc: The Eruption Pokémon. Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon's back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.

species.name: Torkoal
species.desc: The Coal Pokémon. Torkoal generates energy by burning coal. It grows weaker as the fire dies down. When it is preparing for battle, this Pokémon burns more coal.

species.name: Spoink
species.desc: The Bounce Pokémon. Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon's psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.

species.name: Grumpig
species.desc: The Manipulate Pokémon. Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon's black pearls are valuable as works of art.

species.name: Spinda
species.desc: The Spot Panda Pokémon. All the Spinda that exist in the world are said to have utterly unique spot patterns. The shaky, tottering steps of this Pokémon give it the appearance of dancing.

species.name: Trapinch
species.desc: The Ant Pit Pokémon. Trapinch is a patient hunter. It digs an inescapable pit in a desert and waits for its prey to come tumbling down. This Pokémon can go a whole week without access to any water.

species.name: Vibrava
species.desc: The Vibration Pokémon. Vibrava's wings have not yet completed the process of growing. Rather than flying long distances, they are more useful for generating ultrasonic waves by vibrating.

species.name: Flygon
species.desc: The Mystic Pokémon. Flygon is nicknamed the elemental spirit of the desert.  Because its flapping wings whip up a cloud of sand, this Pokémon is always enveloped in a sandstorm while flying.

species.name: Cacnea
species.desc: The Cactus Pokémon. The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

species.name: Cacturne
species.desc: The Scarecrow Pokémon. During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.

species.name: Swablu
species.desc: The Cotton Bird Pokémon. Swablu has light and fluffy wings that are like cottony clouds. This Pokémon is not frightened of people. It lands on the heads of people and sits there like a cotton-fluff hat.

species.name: Altaria
species.desc: The Humming Pokémon. Altaria sings in a gorgeous soprano. Its wings are like cotton clouds. This Pokémon catches updrafts with its buoyant wings and soars way up into the wild blue yonder.

species.name: Zangoose
species.desc: The Cat Ferret Pokémon. Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose's body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.

species.name: Seviper
species.desc: The Fang Snake Pokémon. Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.

species.name: Lunatone
species.desc: The Meteorite Pokémon. Lunatone was discovered at a location where a meteoroid fell. As a result, some people theorize that this Pokémon came from space. However, no one has been able to prove this theory so far.

species.name: Solrock
species.desc: The Meteorite Pokémon. Solrock is a new species of Pokémon that is said to have fallen from space. It floats in air and moves silently. In battle, this Pokémon releases intensely bright light.

species.name: Barboach
species.desc: The Whiskers Pokémon. Barboach's sensitive whiskers serve as a superb radar system. This Pokémon hides in mud, leaving only its two whiskers exposed while it waits for prey to come along.

species.name: Whiscash
species.desc: The Whiskers Pokémon. If Whiscash goes on a wild rampage, it sets off a quake-like tremor with a radius of over three miles. This Pokémon has the ability to predict real earthquakes.

species.name: Corphish
species.desc: The Ruffian Pokémon. Corphish catches prey with its sharp claws. It has no likes or dislikes when it comes to food-it will eat anything. This Pokémon has no trouble living in filthy water.

species.name: Crawdaunt
species.desc: The Rogue Pokémon. Crawdaunt molts (sheds) its shell regularly. Immediately after molting, its shell is soft and tender. Until the shell hardens, this Pokémon hides in its streambed burrow to avoid attack from its foes.

species.name: Baltoy
species.desc: The Clay Doll Pokémon. Baltoy moves while spinning around on its one foot. Primitive wall paintings depicting this Pokémon living among people were discovered in some ancient ruins.

species.name: Claydol
species.desc: The Clay Doll Pokémon. Claydol are said to be dolls of mud made by primitive humans and brought to life by exposure to a mysterious ray. This Pokémon moves about while levitating.

species.name: Lileep
species.desc: The Sea Lily Pokémon. Lileep is an ancient Pokémon that was regenerated from a fossil. It remains permanently anchored to a rock. From its immobile perch, this Pokémon intently scans for prey with its two eyes.

species.name: Cradily
species.desc: The Barnacle Pokémon. Cradily's body serves as an anchor, preventing it from being washed away in rough seas. This Pokémon secretes a strong digestive fluid from its tentacles.

species.name: Anorith
species.desc: The Old Shrimp Pokémon. Anorith was regenerated from a prehistoric fossil. This primitive Pokémon once lived in warm seas. It grips its prey firmly between its two large claws.

species.name: Armaldo
species.desc: The Plate Pokémon. Armaldo is a Pokémon species that became extinct in prehistoric times. This Pokémon is said to have walked on its hind legs, which would have been more convenient for life on land.

species.name: Feebas
species.desc: The Fish Pokémon. Feebas's fins are ragged and tattered from the start of its life. Because of its shoddy appearance, this Pokémon is largely ignored. It is capable of living in both the sea and in rivers.

species.name: Milotic
species.desc: The Tender Pokémon. Milotic is said to be the most beautiful of all the Pokémon. It has the power to becalm such emotions as anger and hostility to quell bitter feuding.

species.name: Castform
species.desc: The Weather Pokémon. Castform's appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

species.name: Rainy Castform
species.desc: The Weather Pokémon. Castform's appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

species.name: Snowy Castform
species.desc: The Weather Pokémon. Castform's appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

species.name: Sunny Castform
species.desc: The Weather Pokémon. Castform's appearance changes with the weather. This Pokémon gained the ability to use the vast power of nature to protect its tiny body.

species.name: Kecleon
species.desc: The Color Swap Pokémon. Kecleon is capable of changing its body colors at will to blend in with its surroundings. There is one exception-this Pokémon can't change the zigzag pattern on its belly.

species.name: Shuppet
species.desc: The Puppet Pokémon. Shuppet grows by feeding on dark emotions, such as vengefulness and envy, in the hearts of people. It roams through cities in search of grudges that taint people.

species.name: Banette
species.desc: The Marionette Pokémon. Banette generates energy for laying strong curses by sticking pins into its own body. This Pokémon was originally a pitiful plush doll that was thrown away.

species.name: Duskull
species.desc: The Requiem Pokémon. Duskull can pass through any wall no matter how thick it may be. Once this Pokémon chooses a target, it will doggedly pursue the intended victim until the break of dawn.

species.name: Dusclops
species.desc: The Beckon Pokémon. Dusclops's body is completely hollow-there is nothing at all inside. It is said that its body is like a black hole. This Pokémon will absorb anything into its body, but nothing will ever come back out.

species.name: Tropius
species.desc: The Fruit Pokémon. Children of the southern tropics eat as snacks the fruit that grows in bunches around the neck of Tropius. This Pokémon flies by flapping the leaves on its back as if they were wings.

species.name: Chimecho
species.desc: The Wind Chime Pokémon. Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.

species.name: Absol
species.desc: The Disaster Pokémon. Every time Absol appears before people, it is followed by a disaster such as an earthquake or a tidal wave. As a result, it came to be known as the disaster Pokémon.

species.name: Wynaut
species.desc: The Bright Pokémon. Wynaut can always be seen with a big, happy smile on its face. Look at its tail to determine if it is angry. When angered, this Pokémon will be slapping the ground with its tail.

species.name: Snorunt
species.desc: The Snow Hat Pokémon. Snorunt survives by eating only snow and ice. Old folklore claims that a house visited by this Pokémon is sure to prosper for many generations to come.
evTo: Froslass (level 14, female only, using Dawn Stone)

species.name: Glalie
species.desc: The Face Pokémon. Glalie has a body made of rock, which it hardens with an armor of ice. This Pokémon has the ability to freeze moisture in the atmosphere into any shape it desires.

species.name: Spheal
species.desc: The Clap Pokémon. Spheal always travels by rolling around on its ball-like body. When the season for ice floes arrives, this Pokémon can be seen rolling about on ice and crossing the sea.

species.name: Sealeo
species.desc: The Ball Roll Pokémon. Sealeo has the habit of always juggling on the tip of its nose anything it sees for the first time. This Pokémon occasionally entertains itself by balancing and rolling a Spheal on its nose.

species.name: Walrein
species.desc: The Ice Break Pokémon. Walrein swims all over in frigid seawater while crushing icebergs with its grand, imposing tusks. Its thick layer of blubber makes enemy attacks bounce off harmlessly.

species.name: Clamperl
species.desc: The Bivalve Pokémon. Clamperl's sturdy shell is not only good for protection-it is also used for clamping and catching prey. A fully grown Clamperl's shell will be scored with nicks and scratches all over.

species.name: Huntail
species.desc: The Deep Sea Pokémon. Huntail's tail is shaped like a fish. It uses the tail to attract prey, then swallows the prey whole with its large, gaping mouth. This Pokémon swims by wiggling its slender body like a snake.

species.name: Gorebyss
species.desc: The South Sea Pokémon. Although Gorebyss is the very picture of elegance and beauty while swimming, it is also cruel. When it spots prey, this Pokémon inserts its thin mouth into the prey's body and drains the prey of its body fluids.

species.name: Relicanth
species.desc: The Longevity Pokémon. Relicanth is a Pokémon species that existed for a hundred million years without ever changing its form. This ancient Pokémon feeds on microscopic organisms with its toothless mouth.

species.name: Luvdisc
species.desc: The Rendezvous Pokémon. Luvdisc live in shallow seas in the tropics. This heart-shaped Pokémon earned its name by swimming after loving couples it spotted in the ocean's waves.

species.name: Bagon
species.desc: The Rock Head Pokémon. Bagon has a dream of one day soaring in the sky. In doomed efforts to fly, this Pokémon hurls itself off cliffs. As a result of its dives, its head has grown tough and as hard as tempered steel.

species.name: Shelgon
species.desc: The Endurance Pokémon. Covering Shelgon's body are outgrowths much like bones. The shell is very hard and bounces off enemy attacks. When awaiting evolution, this Pokémon hides away in a cavern.

species.name: Salamence
species.desc: The Dragon Pokémon. By evolving into Salamence, this Pokémon finally realizes its long-held dream of growing wings. To express its joy, it flies and wheels all over the sky while spouting flames from its mouth.

species.name: Beldum
species.desc: The Iron Ball Pokémon. Instead of blood, a powerful magnetic force courses throughout Beldum's body. This Pokémon communicates with others by sending controlled pulses of magnetism.

species.name: Metang
species.desc: The Iron Claw Pokémon. When two Beldum fuse together, Metang is formed. The brains of the Beldum are joined by a magnetic nervous system. This Pokémon turns its arms to the rear for traveling at high speed.

species.name: Metagross
species.desc: The Iron Leg Pokémon. Metagross has four brains in total. Combined, the four brains can breeze through difficult calculations faster than a supercomputer. This Pokémon can float in the air by tucking in its four legs.

species.name: Regirock
species.desc: The Rock Peak Pokémon. Regirock was sealed away by people long ago. If this Pokémon's body is damaged in battle, it is said to seek out suitable rocks on its own to repair itself.

species.name: Regice
species.desc: The Iceberg Pokémon. Regice's body was made during an ice age. The deep-frozen body can't be melted, even by fire. This Pokémon controls frigid air of -328 degrees Fahrenheit.

species.name: Registeel
species.desc: The Iron Pokémon. Registeel has a body that is harder than any kind of metal. Its body is apparently hollow. No one has any idea what this Pokémon eats.

species.name: Latias
species.desc: The Eon Pokémon. Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.

species.name: Latios
species.desc: The Eon Pokémon. Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.

species.name: Kyogre
species.desc: The Sea Basin Pokémon. Through Primal Reversion and with nature's full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

species.name: Kyogre (Primal)
species.desc: The Sea Basin Pokémon. Through Primal Reversion and with nature's full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.

species.name: Groudon
species.desc: The Continent Pokémon. Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

species.name: Groudon (Primal)
species.desc: The Continent Pokémon. Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.

species.name: Rayquaza
species.desc: The Sky High Pokémon. Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.

species.name: Jirachi
species.desc: The Wish Pokémon. Jirachi will awaken from its sleep of a thousand years if you sing to it in a voice of purity. It is said to make true any wish that people desire.

species.name: Deoxys
species.desc: The DNA Pokémon. The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon's chest appears to be its brain.

species.name: Turtwig
species.desc: The Tiny Leaf Pokémon. Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.

species.name: Grotle
species.desc: The Grove Pokémon. It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.

species.name: Torterra
species.desc: The Continent Pokémon. Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.

species.name: Chimchar
species.desc: The Chimp Pokémon. It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.

species.name: Monferno
species.desc: The Playful Pokémon. To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.

species.name: Infernape
species.desc: The Flame Pokémon. It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.

species.name: Piplup
species.desc: The Penguin Pokémon. Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.

species.name: Prinplup
species.desc: The Penguin Pokémon. It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

species.name: Empoleon
species.desc: The Emperor Pokémon. The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.

species.name: Starly
species.desc: The Starling Pokémon. They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.

species.name: Staravia
species.desc: The Starling Pokémon. It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.

species.name: Staraptor
species.desc: The Predator Pokémon. It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.

species.name: Bidoof
species.desc: The Plump Mouse Pokémon. With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.

species.name: Bibarel
species.desc: The Beaver Pokémon. It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.

species.name: Kricketot
species.desc: The Cricket Pokémon. It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.

species.name: Kricketune
species.desc: The Cricket Pokémon. It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

species.name: Shinx
species.desc: The Flash Pokémon. All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.

species.name: Luxio
species.desc: The Spark Pokémon. Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.

species.name: Luxray
species.desc: The Gleam Eyes Pokémon. It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.

species.name: Budew
species.desc: The Bud Pokémon. Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

species.name: Roserade
species.desc: The Bouquet Pokémon. It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.

species.name: Cranidos
species.desc: The Head Butt Pokémon. It lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its skull is as hard as iron.

species.name: Rampardos
species.desc: The Head Butt Pokémon. Its powerful head butt has enough power to shatter even the most durable things upon impact.

species.name: Shieldon
species.desc: The Shield Pokémon. A Pokémon that lived in jungles around 100 million years ago. Its facial hide is extremely hard.

species.name: Bastiodon
species.desc: The Shield Pokémon. Any frontal attack is repulsed. It is a docile Pokémon that feeds on grass and berries.

species.name: Burmy
species.desc: The Bagworm Pokémon. To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
evTo: Wormadam Plant Cloak (level 6, female only, in a tall grass/forest)
Wormadam Sand Cloak (level 6, female only, in a tall cave/desert/mountain)
Wormadam Trash Cloak (level 6, female only, in a city or building)

species.name: Wormadam Plant Cloak
species.desc: The Bagworm Pokémon. When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

species.name: Wormadam Sand Cloak
species.desc: The Bagworm Pokémon. When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

species.name: Wormadam Trash Cloak
species.desc: The Bagworm Pokémon. When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.

species.name: Mothim
species.desc: The Moth Pokémon. It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.

species.name: Combee
species.desc: The Tiny Bee Pokémon. A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to Vespiquen.

species.name: Vespiquen
species.desc: The Beehive Pokémon. Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by Combee.

species.name: Pachirisu
species.desc: The EleSquirrel Pokémon. It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.

species.name: Buizel
species.desc: The Sea Weasel Pokémon. It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.

species.name: Floatzel
species.desc: The Sea Weasel Pokémon. It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

species.name: Cherubi
species.desc: The Cherry Pokémon. The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.

species.name: Cherrim
species.desc: The Blossom Pokémon. It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

species.name: Shellos
species.desc: The Sea Slug Pokémon. Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

species.name: Gastrodon
species.desc: The Sea Slug Pokémon. It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

species.name: Ambipom
species.desc: The Long Tail Pokémon. To eat, it deftly shucks nuts with its two tails. It rarely uses its arms now.

species.name: Drifloon
species.desc: The Balloon Pokémon. A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.

species.name: Drifblim
species.desc: The Blimp Pokémon. It’s drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.

species.name: Buneary
species.desc: The Rabbit Pokémon. It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.

species.name: Lopunny
species.desc: The Rabbit Pokémon. An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.

species.name: Mismagius
species.desc: The Magical Pokémon. Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.

species.name: Honchkrow
species.desc: The Big Boss Pokémon. Becoming active at night, it is known to swarm with numerous MURKROW in tow.

species.name: Glameow
species.desc: The Catty Pokémon. It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.

species.name: Purugly
species.desc: The Tiger Cat Pokémon. It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.

species.name: Chingling
species.desc: The Bell Pokémon. It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.

species.name: Stunky
species.desc: The Skunk Pokémon. It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.

species.name: Skuntank
species.desc: The Skunk Pokémon. It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.

species.name: Bronzor
species.desc: The Bronze Pokémon. Implements shaped like it were discovered in ancient tombs. It is unknown if they are related.

species.name: Bronzong
species.desc: The Bronze Bell Pokémon. One caused a news sensation when it was dug up at a construction site after a 2,000-year sleep.

species.name: Bonsly
species.desc: The Bonsai Pokémon. It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body’s fluid levels by eliminating excess.

species.name: Mime Jr.
species.desc: The Mime Pokémon. It habitually mimics foes. Once mimicked, the foe cannot take its eyes off this Pokémon.
evTo: Galarian Mr. Mime (knowing Mimic, in a region of typically cool climate)

species.name: Happiny
species.desc: The Playhouse Pokémon. It loves round white things. It carries an egg-shaped rock in imitation of CHANSEY.

species.name: Chatot
species.desc: The Music Note Pokémon. It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

species.name: Spiritomb
species.desc: The Forbidden Pokémon. A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.

species.name: Gible
species.desc: The Land Shark Pokémon. It nests in small, horizontal holes in cave walls. It pounces to catch prey that stray too close.

species.name: Gabite
species.desc: The Cave Pokémon. There is a long-held belief that medicine made from its scales will heal even incurable illnesses.

species.name: Garchomp
species.desc: The Mach Pokémon. When it folds up its body and extends its wings, it looks like a jet plane. It flies at sonic speed.

species.name: Munchlax
species.desc: The Big Eater Pokémon. It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.

species.name: Riolu
species.desc: The Emanation Pokémon. The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.

species.name: Lucario
species.desc: The Aura Pokémon. It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.

species.name: Hippopotas
species.desc: The Hippo Pokémon. It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.

species.name: Hippowdon
species.desc: The Heavyweight Pokémon. It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.

species.name: Skorupi
species.desc: The Scorpion Pokémon. It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.

species.name: Drapion
species.desc: The Ogre Scorpion Pokémon. It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.

species.name: Croagunk
species.desc: The Toxic Mouth Pokémon. Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.

species.name: Toxicroak
species.desc: The Toxic Mouth Pokémon. Its knuckle claws secrete a toxin so vile that even a scratch could prove fatal.

species.name: Carnivine
species.desc: The Bug Catcher Pokémon. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.

species.name: Finneon
species.desc: The Wing Fish Pokémon. After long exposure to sunlight, the patterns on its tail fins shine vividly when darkness arrives.

species.name: Lumineon
species.desc: The Neon Pokémon. It lives on the deep-sea floor. It attracts prey by flashing the patterns on its four tail fins.

species.name: Mantyke
species.desc: The Kite Pokémon. A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
evTo: Mantine (level 8, when Remoraid is also in the party)

species.name: Snover
species.desc: The Frost Tree Pokémon. It lives on snowy mountains. Having had little contact with humans, it is boldly inquisitive.

species.name: Abomasnow
species.desc: The Frost Tree Pokémon. It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

species.name: Weavile
species.desc: The Sharp Claw Pokémon. They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.

species.name: Magnezone
species.desc: The Magnet Area Pokémon. It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.

species.name: Lickilicky
species.desc: The Licking Pokémon. It wraps things with its extensible tongue. Getting too close to it will leave you soaked with drool.

species.name: Rhyperior
species.desc: The Drill Pokémon. It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.

species.name: Tangrowth
species.desc: The Vine Pokémon. It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

species.name: Electivire
species.desc: The Thunderbolt Pokémon. It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.

species.name: Magmortar
species.desc: The Blast Pokémon. It blasts fireballs of over 3,600 degrees F from the ends of its arms. It lives in volcanic craters.

species.name: Togekiss
species.desc: The Jubilee Pokémon. It will never appear where there is strife. Its sightings have become rare recently.

species.name: Yanmega
species.desc: The Ogre Darner Pokémon. By churning its wings, it creates shock waves that inflict critical internal injuries to foes.

species.name: Leafeon
species.desc: The Verdant Pokémon. Just like a plant, it uses photosynthesis. As a result, it is always enveloped in clear air.

species.name: Glaceon
species.desc: The Fresh Snow Pokémon. As a protective technique, it can completely freeze its fur to make its hairs stand like needles.

species.name: Gliscor
species.desc: The Fang Scorpion Pokémon. It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!

species.name: Mamoswine
species.desc: The Twin Tusk Pokémon. Its impressive tusks are made of ice. The population thinned when it turned warm after the ice age.

species.name: Porygon-Z
species.desc: The Virtual Pokémon. Additional software was installed to make it a better Pokémon. It began acting oddly, however.

species.name: Gallade
species.desc: The Blade Pokémon. A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

species.name: Probopass
species.desc: The Compass Pokémon. It exudes strong magnetism from all over. It controls three small units called Mini-Noses.

species.name: Dusknoir
species.desc: The Gripper Pokémon. The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.

species.name: Froslass
species.desc: The Snow Land Pokémon. It freezes foes with an icy breath nearly -60 degrees F. What seems to be its body is actually hollow.

species.name: Rotom
species.desc: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: Rotom Fan
species.desc: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: Rotom Frost
species.desc: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: Rotom Heat
species.desc: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: Rotom Mow
species.desc: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: Rotom Wash
species.desc: The Plasma Pokémon. Its body is composed of plasma. It is known to infiltrate electronic devices and wreak havoc.

species.name: Uxie
species.desc: The Knowledge Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.

species.name: Mesprit
species.desc: The Emotion Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.

species.name: Azelf
species.desc: The Willpower Pokémon. Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.

species.name: Dialga
species.desc: The Temporal Pokémon. It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.

species.name: Dialga (Origin Forme)
species.desc: The Temporal Pokémon. Radiant light caused Dialga to take on a form bearing a striking resemblance to the creator Pokémon. Dialga now wields such colossal strength that one must conclude this is its true form.

species.name: Palkia
species.desc: The Spatial Pokémon. It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.

species.name: Palkia (Origin Forme)
species.desc: The Spatial Pokémon. It soars across the sky in a form that greatly resembles the creator of all things. Perhaps this imitation of appearance is Palkia’s strategy for gaining Arceus’s powers.

species.name: Heatran
species.desc: The Lava Dome Pokémon. It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.

species.name: Regigigas
species.desc: The Colossal Pokémon. There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.

species.name: Giratina Altered Forme
species.desc: The Renegade Pokémon. A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

species.name: Giratina Origin Forme
species.desc: The Renegade Pokémon. A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

species.name: Cresselia
species.desc: The Lunar Pokémon. Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

species.name: Phione
species.desc: The Sea Drifter Pokémon. A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.

species.name: Manaphy
species.desc: The Seafaring Pokémon. Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.

species.name: Darkrai
species.desc: The Pitch-Black Pokémon. It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.

species.name: Shaymin Land
species.desc: The Gratitude Pokémon. It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

species.name: Shaymin Sky
species.desc: The Gratitude Pokémon. It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

species.name: Arceus
species.desc: The Alpha Pokémon. It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

species.name: Victini
species.desc: The Victory Pokémon. It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.

species.name: Snivy
species.desc: The Grass Snake Pokémon. They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.

species.name: Servine
species.desc: The Grass Snake Pokémon. They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.

species.name: Serperior
species.desc: The Regal Pokémon. They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.

species.name: Tepig
species.desc: The Fire Pig Pokémon. It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.

species.name: Pignite
species.desc: The Fire Pig Pokémon. Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.

species.name: Emboar
species.desc: The Mega Fire Pig Pokémon. It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.

species.name: Oshawott
species.desc: The Sea Otter Pokémon. The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.

species.name: Dewott
species.desc: The Discipline Pokémon. Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.

species.name: Hisuian Samurott
species.desc: The Formidable Pokémon. Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon’s evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.

species.name: Samurott
species.desc: The Formidable Pokémon. Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.

species.name: Patrat
species.desc: The Scout Pokémon. Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.

species.name: Watchog
species.desc: The Lookout Pokémon. They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.

species.name: Lillipup
species.desc: The Puppy Pokémon. The long hair around its face provides an amazing radar that lets it sense subtle changes in its surroundings.

species.name: Herdier
species.desc: The Loyal Dog Pokémon. It loyally follows its Trainer's orders. For ages, they have helped Trainers raise Pokémon.

species.name: Stoutland
species.desc: The Big-Hearted Pokémon. This extremely wise Pokémon excels at rescuing people stranded at sea or in the mountains.

species.name: Purrloin
species.desc: The Devious Pokémon. Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.

species.name: Liepard
species.desc: The Cruel Pokémon. Stealthily, it sneaks up on its target, striking from behind before its victim has a chance to react.

species.name: Pansage
species.desc: The Grass Monkey Pokémon. It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.

species.name: Simisage
species.desc: The Thorn Monkey Pokémon. It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.

species.name: Pansear
species.desc: The High Temp Pokémon. This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.

species.name: Simisear
species.desc: The Ember Pokémon. A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.

species.name: Panpour
species.desc: The Spray Pokémon. It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.

species.name: Simipour
species.desc: The Geyser Pokémon. The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.

species.name: Munna
species.desc: The Dream Eater Pokémon. It eats the dreams of people and Pokémon. When it eats a pleasant dream, it expels pink-colored mist.

species.name: Musharna
species.desc: The Drowsing Pokémon. With the mist from its forehead, it can create shapes of things from dreams it has eaten.

species.name: Pidove
species.desc: The Tiny Pigeon Pokémon. These Pokémon live in cities. They are accustomed to people. Flocks often gather in parks and plazas.

species.name: Tranquill
species.desc: The Wild Pigeon Pokémon. Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.

species.name: Unfezant
species.desc: The Proud Pokémon. Males have plumage on their heads. They will never let themselves feel close to anyone other than their Trainers.

species.name: Blitzle
species.desc: The Electrified Pokémon. When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.

species.name: Zebstrika
species.desc: The Thunderbolt Pokémon. This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it's angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.

species.name: Roggenrola
species.desc: The Mantle Pokémon. They were discovered a hundred years ago in an earthquake fissure. Inside each one is an energy core.

species.name: Boldore
species.desc: The Ore Pokémon. Because its energy was too great to be contained, the energy leaked and formed orange crystals.

species.name: Gigalith
species.desc: The Compressed Pokémon. The solar energy absorbed by its body's orange crystals is magnified internally and fired from its mouth.

species.name: Woobat
species.desc: The Bat Pokémon. Suction from its nostrils enables it to stick to cave walls during sleep. It leaves a heart-shaped mark behind.

species.name: Swoobat
species.desc: The Courting Pokémon. Anyone who comes into contact with the ultrasonic waves emitted by a courting male experiences a positive mood shift.

species.name: Drilbur
